<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="314" y1="25" x2="314" y2="21" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="25" x2="319" y2="18" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="25" x2="324" y2="15" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="21" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="18" x2="343" y2="24" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="352" y="15" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="355" y="18" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="375" y="19" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="39,67 28,78 39,89" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="29" y1="78" x2="53" y2="78" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="24" y="132" font-family="Poppins" font-size="28" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Reset password</text>
    <text x="24" y="163" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Create a strong password to protect your account.</text>
    <circle cx="349" cy="126" r="20" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="341" y="126" width="16" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M344 126 C344 116 354 116 354 126" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M346 126 C346 119 352 119 352 126" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="205" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">New password</text>
    <rect x="23" y="216" width="344" height="54" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="24" y="214" width="342" height="54" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="36" y="247" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">••••••••••••</text>
    <path d="M326 241 C333 231 344 231 352 241" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M326 241 C333 251 344 251 352 241" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="339" cy="241" r="3.2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="24" y="290" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Use at least 8 characters, including a number.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Confirm password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="330" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Confirm new password</text>
    <rect x="23" y="341" width="344" height="54" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="24" y="339" width="342" height="54" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="372" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">••••••••••••</text>
    <path d="M326 366 C333 356 344 356 352 366" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M326 366 C333 376 344 376 352 366" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="339" cy="366" r="3.2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="24" y="415" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Make sure both passwords match.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Password guidance card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="449" width="344" height="110" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.13"/>
    <rect x="24" y="447" width="342" height="110" rx="6" fill="#25282C"/>
    <text x="40" y="475" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Password strength</text>
    <rect x="40" y="488" width="94" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <rect x="139" y="488" width="94" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <rect x="238" y="488" width="94" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#50545B"/>
    <text x="40" y="516" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Good — add a symbol for extra security.</text>
    <circle cx="42" cy="538" r="4" fill="#00BA88"/>
    <polyline points="40,538 42,540 46,535" fill="none" stroke="#1C1E21" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="54" y="542" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Your password is private and encrypted.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Submit button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="589" width="342" height="52" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="24" y="587" width="342" height="52" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="620" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Submit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Support link -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="681" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Having trouble?</text>
    <text x="195" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Contact support</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="773" width="390" height="71" fill="#000000" opacity="0.22"/>
    <rect x="0" y="771" width="390" height="73" fill="#25282C"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="771" x2="366" y2="771" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <g>
      <polygon points="43,795 53,786 63,795" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="46" y="794" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="53" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="145" cy="797" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="151" y1="804" x2="157" y2="810" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="145" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="235" y="788" width="15" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="239,793 246,793 246,800 239,800" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <text x="243" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="337" cy="794" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="337" cy="806" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="337" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
